# Product Hero

`hero/product` &middot; section-level &middot; category: hero

## Purpose

A single product feature: image, eyebrow, name, description, price and button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `name` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `price` | text |  |
| `salePrice` | text |  |
| `discount` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered product feature with the image on top.
- **left**: Left-aligned text under the image. Sets `align: left`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables and text honored. | Fine. The image is a real img. | Swaps via dm-* classes on the brand surface or background. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('hero/product', {
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/600x480/png?text=Linen%20Shirt",
    "alt": "The Coastal linen shirt in sand, front view"
  },
  "eyebrow": "Just landed",
  "name": "The Coastal Linen Shirt",
  "description": "Relaxed, breathable and softer with every wash. Cut from European flax in three colors.",
  "price": "$120.00",
  "salePrice": "$96.00",
  "discount": "Save 20%",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the shirt",
    "href": "https://example.com/products/coastal-linen-shirt"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):
